method.first_token: timestamp immediately after actual greedy sample following real suffix prefill, before child cleanup
method.oracle: independent full text tokenization/prefill on a fresh session before each fixture, exact full tokens and greedy result matched
method.memory: RSS before/after only; no allocation peak tracer; upstream tensor I/O scratch not individually instrumented

limits: Not integrated into automatic agentctl tool/subagent scheduling; no eviction predictor or priority scheduler
Sequence-file snapshots are private immutable temporary products, same engine and exact live session revision only
No external/untrusted snapshot import, cryptographic full-file checksum, durable fsync or crash recovery
Cancellation stops publication/commit at native-call boundary, not the I/O operation mid-call
No shrinking/releasing of preallocated device KV buffer; explicit eviction frees logical cells for reuse
Snapshot token_count is zero; canonical token history stays in its original pool
Separate snapshot files can duplicate a shared prefix; no disk prefix deduplication or arbitrary block paging
Snapshot-save cost excluded from restoration-stage speedups; must be included for complete workload decisions
OS page-cache warm and Metal unified memory; results do not establish cold SSD or Windows/CUDA performance
Seven samples are insufficient for reliable p95/p99 or a tail-latency stability claim
Dense-history early case includes an outlier; heavy new prefill and short assembly cases did not improve overall
Restore duration itself varied between modes, so total median differences cannot all be attributed to overlap
